Perfect! The feature has been successfully implemented. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Changes Made

### 1. Added `renderSummary()` function to `src/gate/report.ts`
- Returns a one-line summary in the format: `<VERDICT> <answered>/<total>`
- Total is always 7 (the number of GATE_CHECKS)
- Answered counts how many checks have no block-severity findings
- If there are block findings, appends `: ` followed by the check IDs in GATE_CHECKS order
- Special case: if the gate section is missing (structure finding), returns `BLOCK 0/7: structure`

### 2. Added `--summary` flag to `frai-gate check` command
- Modified `cmdCheck()` in `src/cli.ts` to support the new flag
- Prints only the summary line when `--summary` is used
- Exit codes remain unchanged (1 for BLOCK, 0 otherwise)
- `--json` takes priority if both flags are provided
- Updated HELP text to document the new flag

### 3. Added comprehensive tests
- Created `src/gate/report.test.ts` with 7 test cases covering:
  - Missing gate section (structure finding)
  - All checks passing
  - Warnings only
  - Block findings with proper ordering
  - Mixed block and warning findings
  - Non-gate-check findings (properly ignored)

### Verification
- ✅ All 18 tests pass (11 existing + 7 new)
- ✅ Build succeeds with `pnpm --filter frai-gate build`
- ✅ CLI works correctly with `--summary`, `--json`, and default text output
- ✅ Exit codes are correct (1 for BLOCK, 0 for PASS/WARN)
- ✅ `--json` takes priority over `--summary` when both are provided
